description: Source code for device_time.c implementing Device.Time data model, including timezone validation, current time retrieval, and timezone environment handling.

methods.name: DEVICE_TIME_Init
methods.description: Initializes the device time component and registers parameters.

methods.name: DEVICE_TIME_Start
methods.description: Caches timezone environment variable and synchronizes with database.

methods.name: NotifyChange_LocalTimeZone
methods.description: Updates cached timezone value after change.

methods.name: GetCurrentLocalTime
methods.description: Returns current local time in ISO8601 format, handling timezone environment variable.

methods.name: tz_skip_name
methods.description: Skips timezone name in POSIX string.

methods.name: tz_skip_word
methods.description: Skips a word in timezone string, allowing alphabetic and optionally numeric characters.

methods.name: tz_skip_hours_minutes_seconds
methods.description: Skips hours:minutes:seconds format in timezone string.

methods.name: tz_skip_number
methods.description: Skips and validates a numeric component within range.

methods.name: tz_skip_dst_definition
methods.description: Skips DST start/end definition in timezone string.

methods.name: tz_skip_month_week_day
methods.description: Skips month.week.day format used in DST definitions.

methods.name: tz_skip_offset
methods.description: Skips timezone offset in POSIX string.
